blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Current leading video generation models can synthesize highly realistic videos, while still frequently violating physical and logical constraints in multi-step reasoning and planning, even after training with large-scale reasoning data or existing diffusion RL methods. We attribute these failures to the conventional video training paradigm, which treats a solution as a fixed-length clip rather than a chain of decisions. We present ViDecide, a decision-centric framework that trains video diffusion models to predict state transitions causally and decide when to stop, with a decision-focused training schedule. We further propose Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT), which corrects failed decisions by mapping their noise to the model's own successful continuations, achieving stable improvement without policy-gradient optimization. Across abstract games, planning tasks, and a new benchmark of multi-step robot planning, ViDecide achieves an average strict success rate of 83.8%, far above 23.3% for standard fine-tuning and 67.8% for the strongest prior method, and generalizes to larger puzzles and unseen layouts. Our framework therefore unlocks greater potential for video generation models as reliable reasoners and planners in the visual world. Project page: https://kevin-thu.github.io/ViDecide.
blocks.zh: 目前领先的视频生成模型可以合成高度现实的视频,同时在多步骤推理和规划中仍然经常违反物理和逻辑限制,即使在使用大规模推理数据或现有的传播RL方法进行培训后. 我们把这些失败归因于传统的视频培训模式,它把一个解决方案视为固定长度的剪辑,而不是一连串的决定. 我们提出ViDecide,这是一个以决策为中心的框架,它培训视频传播模型,以因果预测状态过渡,并决定何时停止,并有一个以决策为重点的培训时间表。 我们进一步提出纠正精细调整(CFT),通过将其噪声映射到模型本身成功的延续上来纠正失败的决定,实现稳定的改进,而不进行政策级优化. 纵观抽象游戏,规划任务,以及多步机器人规划的新基准,ViDecide实现了83.8%的平均严格成功率,标准微调远高于23.3%,最强前置方法则远高于67.8%,并概括为更大的谜题和隐形布局. 因此,我们的框架为视频生成模型释放了更大的潜力,使其成为视觉界的可靠理性者和规划者。 项目网页:https://kevin-thu.github.io/ViDecide.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video generation models are emerging as foundation models for visual intelligence, powering world simulation [ 16 , 57 ] , embodied planning [ 11 , 12 , 25 , 36 ] , and visual reasoning [ 51 , 46 ] .
Just as language models reason step by step in words, video models can natively reason and plan in pixel space, unfolding a solution as a sequence of visual states.
This promise has motivated growing efforts to strengthen the reasoning abilities of video models by fine-tuning on large-scale reasoning data [ 48 , 6 ] and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards [ 53 , 64 ] .
blocks.zh:
视频生成模型正在成为视觉智能的基础模型,为世界模拟提供动力[16,57],体现规划[11,12,25,36],和视觉推理[51,46].
正如语言模型在文字上一步步的理性,视频模型可以在像素空间中本土地理性并规划,将一个解决方案作为视觉状态的序列来展开.
这一承诺促使人们日益努力加强视频模型的推理能力,对大规模推理数据作微调[48,6]并用可核查的奖励加强学习[53,64].

blocks.en:
However, multi-step reasoning and long-horizon planning remain challenging for video diffusion models.
As shown in Fig. 1 , even leading commercial models ( e.g . , Seedance 2.5 [ 3 ] ) and models trained on large-scale reasoning data with RL ( e.g . , VBVR-Pro-RLVR [ 53 ] ) rarely produce valid solutions.
They often hallucinate state transitions that violate the physical or logical task rules, although the final frame sometimes appears to reach the goal.
These failures persist even when a video model is fine-tuned on expert solutions of the target tasks, suggesting that more data or rewards alone cannot resolve the problem.
blocks.zh:
然而,多步骤推理和长视距规划对于视频传播模式来说仍然具有挑战性.
如图1所示,即使是领先的商业模型(如:种子2.5 [3]),以及使用RL进行大规模推理数据培训的模型(如:VBVR-Pro-RLVR [53]),也很少产生有效的解决方案.
他们经常幻觉到违反物理或逻辑任务规则的状态过渡,尽管最终框架有时似乎达到了目标.
即使对视频模型对目标任务的专家解决方案进行了微调,这些失败依然存在,说明仅靠更多的数据或奖励无法解决问题。

blocks.en:
We find that these failures stem from a mismatch between how video diffusion models are trained and what multi-step reasoning requires.
Multi-step reasoning and planning are stateful processes that proceed as a chain of decisions, where each step depends on the previous ones and the reasoning length varies across problems.
Current video diffusion models overlook this structure at three levels. First , they generate all frames of a fixed-length clip jointly.
This ignores the causal order between states and fixes the reasoning length in advance. Second , their training schedule is designed for visual generation, not reasoning.
The model mainly learns to reconstruct visual details at low noise, whereas it must infer state transitions at high noise [ 34 ] . Third , existing diffusion RL methods for video reasoning [ 64 , 53 ] optimize rewards at the video level.
A single reward thus penalizes the entire video for a few incorrect decisions, which makes credit assignment noisy and provides no explicit correction for them.
These mismatches lead video models to mimic solutions rather than solve problems.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,这些失败源于视频传播模型如何培训与多步骤推理需要的不匹配.
多步骤推理和规划是作为一连串决策进行起来的状态过程,每个步骤都取决于前一个步骤,推理长度因问题而异.
目前的视频传播模式在三个层面忽略了这一结构。 首先,它们共同生成固定长片段的所有帧.
这忽略了国与国之间的因果顺序,提前确定了推理长度. 第二,他们的训练时间表是为视觉生成而设计的,而不是推理.
该模型主要学习在低噪声下重建视觉细节,而它必须在高噪声下推断出状态过渡[34]. 第三,视频推理的现有传播RL方法[64,53]在视频层面优化奖励.
一次奖励就惩罚了整个录像,因为作出一些错误的决定,这使信用分配变得吵闹,没有为这些决定提供明确的纠正。
这些不匹配导致视频模型模仿解决方案而不是解决问题.

blocks.en:
Our key insight is to treat decisions as the basic units of video reasoning, each corresponding to a visual state transition.
We present ViDecide , a decision-centric framework that trains video diffusion models to reason and plan. ViDecide generates a reasoning video one segment at a time, each conditioned on all previous states.
To support adaptive termination, we also introduce a visual end-of-sequence (EOS) frame that marks task completion, analogous to the EOS token in language models.
This generation paradigm enforces the causal order of state transitions and adapts the reasoning length to each problem.
Within each segment, reasoning primarily occurs in the early denoising steps, when the next state is not yet visible.
We therefore adopt a decision-focused schedule that shifts flow-matching timesteps toward high noise levels, concentrating training on the decisions themselves.
blocks.zh:
我们的关键洞察力是将决策视为视频推理的基本单位,每个单元都对应视觉状态过渡.
ViDecide是一个以决定为中心的框架, ViDecide一次生成一段推理视频,每个段都以之前所有状态为条件.
为了支持适应性终止,我们还引入了可视的序列终结(EOS)框架来标记任务完成,类似于语言模型中的EOS令牌.
这个世代范式执行状态过渡的因果顺序,并适应每个问题的推理长度.
在每一段内,推理主要发生在早期的去名步骤中,当下一个状态尚未显现出来时.
因此,我们通过一项侧重于决定的时间表,将流量匹配的时间步向高噪音水平转变,集中培训决策本身。

blocks.en:
With these designs, ViDecide can learn valid state transitions from expert videos through supervised training.
At inference, however, the model relies on its own generated states, where a single wrong decision can cause the whole solution to fail.
To correct such failures, ideal supervision should provide explicit corrections for failed decisions and remain within the model’s own distribution, making the corrections easier to learn.
Guided by these principles, we propose Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT) , a new post-training method for autoregressive video diffusion.
CFT first collects failed rollouts from the current model and traces the decisions that led to the failures.
It then maps the noise of each failed decision to a successful alternative resampled from the same history.
These successful resamples provide explicit, in-distribution corrective supervision, making the model more likely to sample successful decisions.
blocks.zh:
通过这些设计,ViDecide可以通过监督培训从专家视频中学习有效的状态过渡.
然而在推论中,模型依赖于其自身生成的状态,其中单一错误的决定会导致整个解决方案失败.
为了纠正这种失误,理想的监督应为失败的决定提供明确的纠正,并保持在模型本身的分布范围内,使纠正更容易学习。
在这些原则的指导下,我们提出纠正精细调整(CFT),这是自动回放视频传播的一种新的训练后方法.
CFT首先从目前的模型中收集失败的推出并追踪导致失败的决定.
然后将每个失败决定的噪声映射为成功从同一历史中重印出来的替代方案.
这些成功的复标提供了明确的,分布式的纠正性监督,使模型更有可能对成功的决定进行抽样.

blocks.en:
To demonstrate the effectiveness of ViDecide , we conduct controlled experiments on three benchmarks ranging from abstract puzzles to embodied manipulation.
A solution counts as successful only if it reaches the goal and every state transition follows the task rules.
We first evaluate on the rule-based games of VideoRLVR [ 64 ] and six planning tasks from VBVR-MultiStep [ 48 ] .
Compared with joint generation, our causal generation with adaptive termination improves the average strict success rate by 48.2 points and outperforms prior video reasoning methods [ 38 , 21 ] on every benchmark.
Compared with training without the timestep shift, the decision-focused schedule improves the average by 37.0 points.
CFT further improves the model on every benchmark, while prior diffusion RL methods [ 29 , 62 ] rarely improve it, even when applied to branches from the failed decisions.
These gains also hold on a DiT-B [ 37 ] trained from scratch on the games.
blocks.zh:
为了证明ViDecide的功效,我们针对从抽象的谜题到隐含的操纵等三个基准进行有控制的实验.
只有达到目标,每一个州的过渡都遵循任务规则,解决方案才算成功。
我们首先评价了基于规则的游戏"VideoRLVR [64]"和从VBVR-MultiStep[48]的六个规划任务.
与联合生成相比,我们的因果生成与适应性终止相比,每个基准的平均严格成功率提高了48.2分,并超过了先前的视频推理方法[38,21].
与没有时间步调变化的培训相比,以决策为重点的时间表提高了平均37.0分。
CFT在每一个基准上都进一步改进了模型,而之前的传播RL方法[29,62]很少加以改进,即使应用到失败决定的分支.
这些收益还维持了在游戏中从零开始训练的DiT-B [37].

blocks.en:
To extend ViDecide to more complex embodied environments, we further build RoboTwin-Plan, a benchmark of multi-step block-planning tasks for a dual-arm robot in RoboTwin 2.0 [ 5 ] . ViDecide solves 78.0% of these tasks, compared with 63.9% for the strongest prior method.
Notably, on these robot videos with rich visual detail, the decision-focused schedule raises the success rate from 33.3% to 73.9% over the default schedule of Wan2.2.
Overall, ViDecide raises the strict success rate of standard fine-tuning on all four test sets in Fig. 1 , from 23.3% to 83.8% on average.
It also generalizes to larger puzzles and unseen layouts beyond the training range, suggesting that it learns transferable rules rather than only mimicking the training solutions.
blocks.zh:
为了将"ViDecide"扩展至更复杂的包含环境,我们进一步构建了"RoboTwin-Plan",这是"RoboTwin 2.0 [5]"中双臂机器人多步区块规划任务的基准. ViDecide解决了78.0%的这些任务,而最强前置方法的解决率为63.9%.
值得注意的是,在这些视觉细节丰富的机器人视频上,以决策为重点的时间表比Wan2.2的默认时间表提高了33.3%至73.9%。
总体而言,ViDecide将图1所有四个测试集的标准微调的严格成功率从23.3%提高到了83.8%。
它还概括到更大的谜题和超出培训范围的看不见的布局,表明它学习可转移的规则,而不只是模仿培训解决方案。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: • A decision-centric framework. We present ViDecide , which combines causal generation, adaptive termination, and a decision-focused training schedule to enable flexible-length, long-horizon video reasoning and planning. • Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT). We propose a new post-training method for autoregressive video diffusion that corrects failed decisions with the model’s own successful continuations, achieving stable improvement without policy-gradient optimization. • State-of-the-art performance. Extensive experiments on abstract games, planning tasks, and robot manipulation show that ViDecide achieves an average strict success rate of 83.8%, against 67.8% for the strongest prior method.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的贡献如下: 一个以决策为中心的框架。 我们介绍ViDecide, 将因果生成、适应性终止和以决定为重点的培训时间表结合起来, • 纠正精细调整。 我们提出一种新的自递式视频传播培训后方法,用模型本身的成功延续来纠正失败的决定,实现稳定的改进,而不进行政策级优化。 • 最新业绩。 对抽象游戏,规划任务,机器人操纵的广泛实验显示,ViDecide取得了83.8%的平均严格成功率,而最强的前作方法为67.8%.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Video Generation for Reasoning. Recent studies have demonstrated the potential of video generation for visual reasoning [ 51 , 46 ] , followed by increasingly diverse benchmarks covering spatial and logical tasks [ 56 , 18 , 48 , 53 , 20 ] .
Existing approaches seek to enhance these capabilities through specialized supervision [ 6 , 48 ] , reinforcement learning [ 30 , 64 , 53 ] , and test-time guidance or search [ 23 , 14 , 7 , 24 ] .
Other studies investigate reasoning mechanisms during the diffusion process [ 49 , 34 , 17 ] , or explore structured generation through hierarchical denoising [ 38 ] and serial-to-parallel diffusion [ 21 ] .
Autoregressive video diffusion models [ 4 , 59 , 22 , 63 ] generate videos causally for long or real-time generation.
Concurrently, ProAR [ 43 ] also generates reasoning videos autoregressively, with a predetermined video length and additional prospective objectives.
However, all of these methods still treat a reasoning video as a fixed-length clip.
We instead treat a reasoning video as a sequence of decisions and redesign the training and post-training paradigms of video models for reliable multi-step reasoning.
blocks.zh:
视频生成理性. 最近的研究表明,视频生成对于视觉推理的潜力[51、46],其次是涵盖空间和逻辑任务的日益多样化的基准[56、18、48、53、20]。
现有办法力求通过专门监督[6、48]、强化学习[30、64、53]以及试验时间指导或搜索[23、14、7、24]来增强这些能力。
其他研究调查了传播过程中的推理机制[49,34,17],或者通过分级去名化[38]和相继相传[21]来探索结构化生成.
自动回放视频传播模式 [4, 59, 22, 63] 因果生成视频,用于长时间或实时生成.
同时,ProAR [43]还自发地生成推理视频,并预设视频长度和额外的预期目标.
然而,所有这些方法仍然把推理视频当作固定长度的剪辑.
相反,我们把推理视频作为一系列决定,并重新设计视频模型的培训和培训后模式,以便进行可靠的多步骤推理。

blocks.en:
Video-based World Modeling and Planning. Video models offer a natural foundation for learning world dynamics and planning through visual generation.
Early works explore planning for robotic manipulation and autonomous driving through generated visual trajectories [ 11 , 12 , 61 ] .
The VideoWorld series learns task-relevant knowledge from unlabeled videos through latent dynamics modeling [ 39 , 40 ] .
More recent world-action models further adapt large-scale video generation models for embodied control [ 25 , 58 , 26 , 13 ] .
Together, these works highlight the potential of video generation to connect world modeling with decision-making.
Our work advances this direction toward reliable task-level planning, with the goal of enabling more capable video-based decision-making systems.
blocks.zh:
视频世界建模与规划. 视频模型为通过视觉生成学习世界动态和规划提供了自然基础.
早期的作品探索通过生成的视觉轨迹进行机器人操纵和自主驾驶的规划[11,12,61].
VideoWorld系列通过潜在动态模型从无标签视频中学习与任务相关的知识[39,40].
更近期的世界行动模型进一步调整了大型视频生成模型,以用于体现的控制[25、58、26、13]。
这些作品一起突出了视频生成将世界模型与决策联系起来的潜力.
我们的工作将这一方向推向可靠的任务层面规划,目标是使基于视频的决策系统更有能力。

blocks.en:
Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models. Reinforcement learning has become an effective approach to aligning diffusion models with task-specific rewards.
Policy-based methods adapt PPO/GRPO-style optimization [ 41 , 42 ] to denoising trajectories [ 2 , 29 , 55 , 19 ] , with recent extensions to video reasoning through verifiable rewards [ 30 , 64 , 53 ] .
Such optimization is expensive and hard to stabilize for high-dimensional video generation.
Recent diffusion-specific approaches explore more efficient and stable reward optimization through regression-based objectives [ 54 , 62 , 1 , 8 , 47 , 50 , 35 ] .
However, existing diffusion RL methods mainly assign one reward to a whole sample, although a failed reasoning video often contains only a few wrong moves.
CFT instead uses model-generated successful continuations to provide targeted supervision for the critical decisions.
blocks.zh:
加强传播模式学习。 加强学习已成为使传播模式与特定任务奖励相一致的有效办法。
以政策为基础的方法使PPO/GRPO风格的优化[41,42]去名化出轨迹[2,29,55,19],最近通过可核查的奖励扩展了视频推理[30,64,53].
这种优化对于高维度视频生成来说是昂贵而难以稳定.
最近针对扩散问题的办法通过基于回归的目标探索更有效和更稳定的奖励优化[54、62、1、8、47、50、35]。
然而,现有的传播RL方法主要给整个样本分配一个奖励,尽管一个失败的推理视频往往只包含几个错误的动作.
反之,CFT使用模型产生的成功续作,为关键决定提供有针对性的监督.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation and Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出和初步性

blocks.en:
Problem Formulation. We consider visual reasoning and planning as conditional video generation.
Given a task description c c and an initial observation 𝐨 0 \mathbf{o}_{0} , the model directly generates a video to solve the task, representing a sequence of visual states τ = ( 𝐨 0 , 𝐨 1 , … , 𝐨 T ) \tau=(\mathbf{o}_{0},\mathbf{o}_{1},\ldots,\mathbf{o}_{T}) .
A successful solution must reach the task goal while maintaining valid state transitions throughout the video. R ⁡ ( τ ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } R(\tau)\in\{0,1\} indicates whether τ \tau successfully solves the task.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 3.2 Causal Diffusion with Adaptive Termination
blocks.zh: 3.2 以适应性终止方式传播原因

blocks.en:
Conventional video diffusion models jointly denoise a fixed-length video, modeling p θ ( 𝐨 1 : T ∣ 𝐨 0 , c ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{o}_{1:T}\mid\mathbf{o}_{0},c) without enforcing the sequential order of decisions.
Empirically, such models struggle to learn the temporal dependencies imposed by task rules and often produce hallucinated states or invalid transitions.
Recent theoretical analyses further highlight the limitations of parallel diffusion in modeling long chains of dependent events [ 32 , 9 ] .
Moreover, a predefined fixed generation horizon is ill-suited to tasks with varying difficulty and lengths.
Inspired by the success of autoregressive reasoning in language models, we instead adopt causal video generation with adaptive termination (Fig. 2 a).
blocks.zh:
常规视频传播模型联合去除固定长度的视频,模型为p θ (o 1 : T ∣ o 0, c ) p _{\ sethata } (\ mathbf{o}_{ 1: T}\mid\ mathbf{o}_{0}, c) 不执行决定顺序.
经验性地说,这种模型在努力学习任务规则所强加的时间依赖性,并经常产生幻觉状态或无效的过渡.
近期的理论分析进一步突出了在建立长期依赖事件链模型时平行传播的局限性[32,9].
此外,预先确定的固定生成地平线不适合难度和长度不一的任务。
在语言模型中自相递进推理的成功激励下,我们改用因果视频生成来适应性终止(图2 a).

blocks.en:
Specifically, we append a visual end-of-sequence (EOS) frame 𝐞 \mathbf{e} to the video trajectory and generate the extended sequence ( 𝐨 1 , … , 𝐨 T , 𝐞 ) (\mathbf{o}_{1},\ldots,\mathbf{o}_{T},\mathbf{e}) autoregressively.
At each step i i , the model generates a temporal segment 𝐗 i \mathbf{X}_{i} spanning up to K K consecutive temporal units (pixel or latent frames).

Each step uses conditional diffusion, trained with standard teacher forcing as in autoregressive language modeling.
This ensures each new segment is generated based on preceding visual states, aligning generation with the causal order of decisions.
We primarily use K = 1 K=1 for rule-based game reasoning, while larger K K suits tasks where each state may last longer, such as embodied manipulation.

Crucially, combining causal generation with a learned visual EOS allows the model to determine when to stop, rather than being constrained by a fixed generation horizon.
Analogous to the EOS token in language models, the visual EOS is generated after task completion and learned directly through the video generation objective, without a separate termination predictor.
At inference, generation stops upon detecting this signal, allowing the reasoning trajectory to adapt its length to the task.

blocks.zh: 3.3 重点突出的培训时间表

blocks.en:
While causal generation follows the order of sequential decisions, standard flow-matching training does not distinguish between learning task-relevant state transitions and refining visual details.
At low noise levels, much of the target appearance is already visible in the noisy input, allowing the model to focus on local reconstruction.
At higher noise levels, however, the target is largely obscured, requiring the model to actually infer what should happen next.

在低噪音水平上,很多目标外观已经在噪音输入中可见出,使模型能够专注于局部重建.
然而,在更高的噪音水平上,目标基本模糊不清,需要模型实际推断接下来会发生什么.

blocks.en: 3.4 Corrective Fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 3.4 校正微调

blocks.en:
Through supervised training, the model learns to reason and plan by imitating expert trajectories step by step.
At inference, however, the model conditions on its own generated history, so a single invalid transition or dead-end move can cause the entire solution to fail.
Reinforcement learning with the success signal R ⁡ ( τ ) R(\tau) can address this in principle, but existing diffusion RL methods spread the reward of a failed video over its many valid transitions, and each transition spans a high-dimensional video segment, so the learning signal for the few wrong decisions is both sparse and noisy.
To address this, we propose Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT) , which builds on causal generation to directly supervise failed decisions (Fig. 2 c).
blocks.zh:
通过监督培训,模型通过一步一步地模仿专家的轨迹来学习理性和计划.
然而在推论中,模型条件本身就生成了历史,因此一个单一的无效的过渡或死端移动会导致整个解决方案失败.
用成功信号R QQ (\ ) R(\tau) 强化学习原则上可以解决这个问题,但现有的传播RL方法将失败视频的奖励分布在它的许多有效过渡上,每次过渡都跨出一个高维视频段,因此少数错误决定的学习信号既稀少又吵闹.
为了解决这个问题,我们提议进行纠正精细调整(CFT),这种调整建立在因果生成的基础上,直接监督失败的决定(图2c)。

blocks.en:
Discussion. CFT differs from existing reward optimization in where and how it assigns credit.
Compared with trajectory-level policy gradients, its supervision is focused on the decisions that led to the failure, and its target is an explicit correction rather than a scalar penalty on the whole video.
Compared with rejection-sampling fine-tuning on successful videos, CFT pairs each correction with the noise that produced the failure.
For a given visual history, different noise realizations induce a distribution over possible decisions.
By pairing the noise that led to a failed continuation with a successful alternative, CFT explicitly redirects these failure-prone samples toward corrected decisions.
Collectively, these corrections encourage the decision distribution to shift toward successful outcomes.
Finally, as a regression objective on the model’s own trajectories, CFT enables stable improvement and fast convergence without requiring policy-gradient optimization for high-dimensional video generation.
Together, these properties turn sparse task-level feedback into targeted decision-level supervision for long-horizon visual reasoning.
blocks.zh:
讨论。 CFT在授信地点和方式上不同于现有的奖励优化.
与轨迹级政策梯度相比,其监督重点是导致失败的决定,其目标则是在整个视频中明确校正而不是平分处罚.
相较于成功视频的拒绝-抽样微调,CFT将每次更正与产生故障的噪音对齐.
对于给定的视觉历史来说,不同的噪声实现会诱发对可能的决定的传播.
CFT通过将导致持续失败的噪音与成功的替代品配对,明确将这些容易发生故障的样本转向纠正的决定。
这些更正集体鼓励决策分配转向成功结果。
最后,作为模型自身轨迹上的回归目标,CFT能够实现稳定的改进和快速的趋同,而无需对高维视频生成进行政策级优化.
这些属性加在一起,将稀少的任务级反馈转化为目标明确的决策级监督,用于长视距的视觉推理.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
To systematically analyze the design of video diffusion models for reasoning and planning, we conduct controlled experiments around three questions, corresponding to the three components of ViDecide :
how to structure the generation process (Sec. 4.2 ),
how to focus training on decisions (Sec. 4.3 ),
and how to learn from its own failures during RL post-training (Sec. 4.4 ).
In each part, we compare our design against representative baselines under a shared protocol and explain why it works.
We further test whether the resulting models generalize beyond the training distribution (Sec. 4.5 ).
blocks.zh:
为了系统地分析用于推理和规划的视频传播模型的设计,我们围绕三个问题进行有控制的实验,这与ViDecide的三个组成部分相对应:
如何构建生成过程(第4.2条),
如何将培训重点放在决策上(第4.3条),
以及如何从自身在RL后培训中的失败中吸取教训(第4.4节)。
在每一部分中,我们根据共同协议,将我们的设计与具有代表性的基线进行比较,并解释它为什么起作用。
我们进一步检验由此产生的模型是否在培训分配之外普遍推广(第4.5节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Benchmarks. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our designs, we evaluate on three complementary benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 基准。 为了显示我们设计的有效性,我们评价了三项相辅相成的基准。

blocks.en:
VideoRLVR [ 64 ] evaluates abstract reasoning on rule-based games, consisting of Maze, FlowFree, and Sokoban, each with 10K training and 1K test puzzles.
Despite simple visuals, they require long sequences of rule-consistent moves.
We train a specialist model for each game.
blocks.zh:
VideoRLVR [64]评价了基于规则的游戏的抽象推理,由Maze,FlowFree和Sokoban组成,每个游戏都有10K训练和1K测试谜题.
尽管视觉简单,但它们需要规则相容动作的长序.
我们每场比赛都要训练一个专家模型.

blocks.en:
VBVR-MultiStep , part of the VBVR suite [ 48 ] , is a large-scale collection of procedurally generated tasks for multi-step video reasoning.
We adopt its six planning tasks, namely Sliding Puzzle, Tower of Hanoi, Snake Routing, Sokoban, TSP Reward Collection, and Ordinal Number Sequence, which differ in rules, visual styles, and solution lengths.
A single generalist model is trained on all tasks, with 5K training and 100 test puzzles per task.
blocks.zh:
VBVR-MultiStep (VBVR-MultiStep),是VBVR套件 [48] 的一部分,是一款大规模由程序生成的任务集,用于多步视频推理.
我们通过了它的六项规划任务,即滑出谜题、河内塔、蛇行跑道、Sokoban、TSP奖项收藏以及标准数字序列,它们的规则、视觉风格和溶液长度各不相同。
一个单一的通论模型在所有任务上都经过了培训,每个任务有5K个培训和100个测试谜题.

blocks.en:
RoboTwin-Plan extends to multi-step planning tasks in embodied environments.
Using the RoboTwin 2.0 [ 5 ] simulator, we build three block-planning tasks for a dual-arm robot: Blocks World, Tower of Hanoi, and Color Sorting, each with two layout variants.
Unlike most logical games, each decision here unfolds over many frames of continuous arm motion.
A single generalist model is trained on 10K episodes and evaluated on 700 test episodes.
blocks.zh:
RoboTwin-Plan扩展至在体现环境中的多步骤规划任务.
使用RoboTwin 2.0 [5] 模拟器,我们为双臂机器人构建了三个块规划任务:Blocks World,河内塔和Collect S排序,每个都有两个布局变体.
与大多数逻辑游戏不同,这里的每个决定都表现在许多连续手臂运动的帧上.
一个单一的通论模型在10K集中接受训练,在700个测试集中接受评价.

blocks.en:
Evaluation metric. Existing evaluations of these benchmarks give credit to videos that break the rules or compare them with a single reference solution.
We instead report the Strict Success Rate (SSR) , which counts a video as solved only if every transition obeys the task rules and the video ends in the goal state [ 27 ] .
On VBVR-MultiStep, whose prompts ask for the shortest solution in five tasks, solutions with redundant moves are also counted as failures.
For each task, a rule verifier parses the state of every generated frame and replays the trajectory.
Verifier details, including the learned state reader for RoboTwin, are provided in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
评价尺度。 对这些基准的现有评价对违反规则的视频给予肯定,或将其与单一的参考解决方案作比较。
只有在每次过渡都遵守任务规则,
在VBVR-MultiStep上,其提示在五个任务中要求最短的解决方案,有冗余动作的解决方案也算作失败.
对于每项任务,规则验证器会解析每个生成帧的状态并重放出轨迹.
补编中提供了验证细节,包括RoboTwin的学习型读取器。

blocks.en:
Implementation details. Our main experiments are built on Wan2.2-5B [ 45 ] , which we fully fine-tune on all benchmarks.
On the discrete games in VideoRLVR, we further validate our findings with DiT-B [ 37 ] , a 132M-parameter pixel-space diffusion transformer trained from scratch.
For Wan2.2-5B, all videos are converted to 384 × 384 384{\times}384 at 16 fps with their native duration, and every training video ends with four EOS frames that repeat the final state with a red border.
Wan2.2-5B models are trained with AdamW and a cosine learning-rate schedule (peak 10 − 5 10^{-5} ) for 10 epochs on VideoRLVR and RoboTwin-Plan and 5 epochs on VBVR-MultiStep.
To ensure a fair comparison, all variants within each comparison share the same data and training budget, and all models, including the baselines, are trained with s = 10 s{=}10 in Eq. ( 4 ) unless otherwise noted.
Fig. 1 instead starts from standard fine-tuning with s = 5 s{=}5 , the default of Wan2.2, so that it also shows the gain of the decision-focused schedule.
At inference, causal models decode new frames on the fly and stop at the first frame whose border pixels are at least 70% red, with a maximum length of 20 s.
Fixed-length baselines generate their training length, which matches the longest training video in each task.
Our models are sampled with 5 denoising steps, and baselines use their own samplers.
Full hyperparameters are listed in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
执行细节。 我们的主要实验建立在Wan2.2-5B[45]上,我们对所有基准进行了充分的微调。
在VideoRLVR的离散游戏上,我们进一步验证了我们与DiT-B[37]的发现,这是从零开始训练的132M-参数空间扩散变压器.
对于Wan2.2-5B来说,所有视频在16个fps时被转换为384×384384\times}384,其原生持续时间,每段训练视频以四个EOS帧结尾,以红色边界重复最终状态.
Wan2.2-5B模型与AdamW和Cosine学习-速率表(高峰10 - 5 10-Q-5})一起被培训,用于VideoRLVR和RoboTwin-Plan上的10个纪元和VBVR-MultiStep上的5个纪元.
为确保进行公平的比较,除非另有说明,每个比较中的所有变体都共享相同的数据和培训预算,所有模型,包括基线,在Eq. (4)中都经过S = 10 s = 10的培训。
图一取而代之,从标准微调起用 s = 5 s = 5 s = 5,即Wan2.2的默认,从而也显示了以决策为重点的时间表的增益.
推断出,由因果模型解码出苍蝇上的新帧并止于第一帧,其边界像素至少为70%的红色,最大长度为20 s.
固定长基线产生训练长度,与每项任务中最长的训练录像相匹配.
我们的模型有5个调试步骤的样本,基线使用自己的样本。
补充材料列出了完整的超参数。

blocks.en: 4.2 Generation Paradigm
blocks.zh: 4.2 世代范式

blocks.en: We first study how the generation process should be structured for multi-step reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们首先研究如何为多步骤推理安排生成过程。

blocks.en:
Baselines. We compare causal generation with adaptive termination against two groups of alternatives.
(1) Zero-shot video generators : the closed-source Seedance 2.5 [ 3 ] and Veo 3.1 [ 15 ] , the open-source Wan2.2-5B [ 45 ] , and the reasoning-tuned VBVR-Wan2.2-A14B [ 48 ] and VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-5B-RLVR [ 53 ] , which are trained on the VBVR task families.
(2) Fixed-length generation : standard bidirectional SFT as in VBVR, which denoises all frames jointly without modifying the architecture; HDR [ 38 ] , which denoises a hierarchy of keyframes from coarse to fine; and S2PD [ 21 ] , which switches from serial to parallel denoising.
HDR and S2PD are implemented on our backbones following their papers.
For ViDecide , we evaluate two segment lengths K K (Sec. 3.2 ): frame-wise generation with K = 1 K{=}1 and chunk-wise generation with K = 8 K{=}8 .
blocks.zh:
基线。 我们比较了因果生成和适应性终止两种替代物。
(1) 零镜头相机: 闭源种子 2.5 [3]和 Veo 3.1 [15],开源 Wan2.2-5B [45],推理调取 VBVR-Wan2.2-A14B [48]和VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-5B-RLVR [53],分别接受VBVR任务家族培训.
(2)固定长度生成:标准双向 SFT 如 VBVR 中,将所有帧联合去除而无需修改架构; HDR [38] 中,将密钥帧的分级从粗到细;以及 S2PD [21] 从相接去除到平行去除.
HDR和S2PD是在我们的骨干部门根据他们的论文执行的。
对于"ViDecide",我们评价了两段长度为K K (Sec. 3.2 ):以K=1K{=}1为框架的生成和以K=8K{=}8为块的生成.

blocks.en:
Results. Causal generation outperforms all alternatives on every benchmark and both backbones (Tab. 1 ).
On FlowFree, for example, frame-wise causal generation reaches 77.9%, while bidirectional SFT and the strongest structured baseline, S2PD, reach 1.1% and 68.1%.
Video models tuned on large-scale reasoning data also perform poorly, with VBVR-Wan2.2 and VBVR-Pro-RLVR solving only 11.3% and 7.7% of VBVR-MultiStep.
As Figs. 3 and 4 show, bidirectional generation fails to learn even the basic rules, and the vast majority of its failures are invalid state transitions.
In contrast, frame-wise causal generation learns valid state transitions and rarely breaks the rules.
Frame-wise generation works best on the puzzles, while chunk-wise generation is best on RoboTwin-Plan, mainly on Blocks World, likely because a single pick-and-place transition lasts about as long as one chunk.
Maze is omitted from Tab. 1 , as it does not require reasoning over state transitions and every paradigm exceeds 98% after training.
blocks.zh:
结果。 因果生成在每一个基准和主干上都超过了所有替代品(第1段)。
例如,在FlowFree上,帧式因子生成率达到77.9%,而双向SFT和最强结构基线S2PD则达到1.1%和68.1%.
以大型推理数据为调制的视频模型也表现不佳,VBVR-Wan2.2和VBVR-Pro-RLVR只解决了11.3%和7.7%的VBVR-MultiStep.
如来相. 3和4显示,双向一代甚至连基本规则都无法学习,其绝大多数失败都是无效的状态过渡.
相形之下,帧因果生成会学习有效的状态过渡,很少会打破规则.
框架式的生成在谜题上效果最好,而块式的生成则在RoboTwin-Plan上效果最好,主要是在Blocks World上,这可能是因为单一的取地过渡持续了大约一块.
Maze在Tab. 1中被省略,因为它不需要在州际过渡上进行推理,每个模式在训练后都会超过98%.

blocks.en: 4.3 Training Schedule
blocks.zh: 4.3 培训时间表

blocks.en:
We next study how training should be distributed over noise levels.
We vary the shift s s with the same data and training budget, where s = 1 s{=}1 recovers the original timestep distribution.
For DiT-B, whose timesteps follow a logit-normal distribution, the same shift moves its mean to log ⁡ s \log s .
Each benchmark uses its best generation paradigm from Sec. 4.2 : frame-wise generation on VideoRLVR and VBVR-MultiStep, and chunk-wise generation on RoboTwin-Plan.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来研究如何在噪音水平上分配培训。
我们用相同的数据和培训预算来改变S的班次,其中S=1 s{=}1恢复了原来的时序分布.
对于DiT-B来说,其时间步跟随了对数-正常分布,同一班次会移动其刻度来记录QQ s\log s.
每个基准使用来自Sec.4.2的最佳生成范式:在VideoRLVR和VBVR-MultiStep上采用帧式生成,在RoboTwin-Plan上采用块式生成.

blocks.en:
Results. Shifting training toward high noise levels improves SSR on every benchmark and both backbones (Tab. 4 ).
Without the shift, DiT-B trained from scratch solves almost no puzzle, whereas s = 10 s{=}10 reaches 58.6% and 73.8%.
RoboTwin-Plan also requires a stronger shift than the default s = 5 s{=}5 of Wan2.2, which reaches only 33.3% against 73.9% at s = 10 s{=}10 , likely because robot videos contain much more visual detail than the puzzles.
Longer training does not close this gap, as the model trained without the shift for 10 epochs (46.8% on FlowFree and 68.4% on Sokoban) remains well below s = 10 s{=}10 trained for only 5 epochs (69.4% and 79.6%).
blocks.zh:
结果。 将培训转向高噪音水平可改进每个基准和主干线的安全部门改革(第4段)。
没有这一转变,从零开始训练的DiT-B几乎不解谜题,而S = 10 s-Q=10则达到58.6%和73.8%.
RoboTwin-Plan还需要比Wan2.2的默认 s = 5 s = 5 s = 5 更强的转会,在 s = 10 s = 10 s = 10 时只达到33.3%,可能是因为机器人视频中包含的视觉细节比谜题要多得多.
更长时间的培训无法弥补这一差距,因为10个世纪的模型(46.8%在Flow Free上,68.4%在Sokoban上)在没有轮班的情况下培训,仍然远远低于10 sXX10,只有5个世纪的模型(69.4%和79.6%)。

blocks.en: 4.4 RL Post-Training
blocks.zh: 4.4 RL 培训后

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Test SSR during post-training on Wan2.2-5B (%), evaluated on the held-out test sets every half epoch. All methods start from the same SFT model at epoch 0.
blocks.zh: 图5:在Wan2.2-5B的后期培训中测试SSSR(百分比),在停产测试中每半个时代都接受过评估。 所有方法都从同一种SFT模型开始,时间为0:00.

blocks.en: Finally, we study how the SFT model can be further improved by learning from its own rollouts.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们研究如何通过学习自己的推出来进一步改进SFT模式。

blocks.en:
Data. As the SFT models already solve 80–90% of the VideoRLVR training puzzles, we add 5,000 harder ones to FlowFree and Sokoban and evaluate on two held-out hard sets of 500 puzzles, FlowFree-Hard and Sokoban-Hard.
On VBVR-MultiStep and RoboTwin-Plan, failures are collected only from the three and four sub-tasks with the lowest success, since the others are already largely solved.
The expert videos mixed into training still cover all sub-tasks.
blocks.zh:
数据。 由于SFT模型已经解决了80-90%的VideoRLVR训练谜题,我们给FlowFree和Sokoban增加了5000个更难的谜题,并对两组被搁置的500个谜题(FlowFree-Hard和Sokoban-Hard)进行了评价。
在"VBVR-MultiStep"和"RoboTwin-Plan"上,失败只从三四子任务中收集到,成功率最低,因为其他任务已经基本解决.
混入培训的专家录像仍然涵盖所有次级任务。

blocks.en:
Baselines. All methods start from the best SFT models of Sec. 4.2 and 4.3 , are trained with the same budget, and are evaluated at their final checkpoint.
Besides continued SFT on expert videos, we compare two families of methods that learn from the model’s own rollouts, with strict success as the reward.
(1) Sample-level methods roll out whole videos for each puzzle: Flow-GRPO [ 29 ] , DiffusionNFT [ 62 ] , and rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT) [ 10 , 60 ] , which fine-tunes on successful rollouts.
Sample-level Flow-GRPO corresponds to the RL used by prior video reasoning models such as VideoRLVR [ 64 ] and VBVR-Pro [ 53 ] .
(2) Decision-level methods instead branch from the decision where a rollout fails and apply the same three objectives to the resulting continuations.
In particular, decision-level RFT trains on the same successful continuations as CFT but with fresh noise and without the extra weight at t = 1 t{=}1 , which makes it an ablation of CFT without noise mapping.
Implementation details of all methods are provided in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
基线。 所有方法都从第4.2和第4.3节的最佳SFT模式开始,由同样的预算培训,并在最后检查站进行评估。
除了在专家视频上继续使用SFT之外,我们比较了从模型本身的推出中吸取教训的两套方法,以严格的成功作为奖励。
(1)样本级方法为每个谜题推出整个视频:Flow-GRPO [29], DifmusionNFT [62],以及拒绝-抽样微调 [RFT [10,60],这些微调对成功推出进行了微调.
样本级Flow-GRPO对应了VideoRLVR [64]和VBVR-Pro [53]等之前的视频推理模型所使用的RL.
(2) 决策一级的方法相对于推出失败的决定的分支,并对由此产生的延续适用相同的三个目标。
特别是决策级的RFT列车在与CFT相同的成功续作上,但有新鲜的噪音,且没有在t=1t{=}1上的额外重量,这使得它成为了没有噪音映射的CFT.
所有方法的执行情况详情见补编。

blocks.en:
Results. CFT further improves the SFT model by 4.1–7.8 points on the original test sets (Tab. 5 ).
Continued SFT on expert videos brings no consistent gain and even lowers SSR on FlowFree and VBVR-MultiStep, so further progress requires learning from the model’s own rollouts.
Flow-GRPO and DiffusionNFT bring little or no gain in these tasks.
Even when branching locates the failed decision, a scalar reward on a high-dimensional segment yields a noisy update.
Branching at decisions alone is not sufficient, as decision-level RFT underperforms sample-level RFT on most test sets and helps mainly on hard puzzles such as Sokoban-Hard.
Noise mapping turns these branches into targeted corrections. CFT improves over decision-level RFT on every original test set, by up to 7.3 points.
Sample-level RFT, the strongest baseline, comes close on the original test sets but lags far behind on Sokoban-Hard and learns much more slowly. As the curves in Fig. 5 show, CFT already improves on every benchmark within half an epoch, e.g . , by more than 20 points on Sokoban-Hard, while on FlowFree and VBVR-MultiStep the other methods are still near or below the SFT model at that point.
blocks.zh:
结果。 CFT进一步改善了SFT模型,在原测试集上增加了4.1–7.8分(Tab. 5.
SFT在专家视频上的持续播放并没有带来一致的好处,甚至降低了SSR在Flow Free和VBVR-MultiStep上的水平,因此要取得进一步的进展,就需要从模型本身的推出中学习。
Flow-GRPO和DivusionNFT为这些任务带来很少或没有好处.
即使分支定位失败的决定,高维段上的分级奖励也会产生出响亮的更新.
单靠决策分行是不够的,因为决策级的RFT在大多数测试集上表现得不如样级的RFT,主要帮助索克班-哈德等硬谜.
噪声映射使这些分支变成了有针对性的矫正. CFT在每次原始测试中比决策级RFT提高,最高可达7.3分.
样本级RFT,最强基线,在原测试集上接近,但在Sokoban-Hard上却远远落后,学习速度要慢得多. 如图5中的曲线所示,CFT已经在半个纪元内改进了每个基准,例如,在Sokoban-Hard上改进了20多分,而在FlowFree和VBVR-MultiStep上,其他方法仍然接近或低于SFT模型。

blocks.en: Comparison with solver corrections. On rule-based games, an exact solver can correct every failed rollout, including those for which no resampled continuation succeeds. Self-generated corrections require a successful resample and cover only about a third as many FlowFree puzzles. However, CFT reaches 84.4% on FlowFree, while training on the solver corrections reaches only 48.2%, as they lie outside the model’s own distribution (see the supplement).
blocks.zh: 与解法修正作比较. 在基于规则的游戏中,一个精确的解析器可以纠正每次失败的推出,包括那些没有再被复制的续作成功. 自我生成的校正需要成功再做一个实例,只覆盖了大约三分之一的"FlowFree"谜题. 然而,CFT在FlowFree上达到了84.4%,而关于解析器矫正的培训则仅达到了48.2%,因为它们处于模型自身分布之外(见补编)。

blocks.en:
Analysis. CFT is designed to redirect the noise of a failed rollout toward a successful decision and, through many such corrections, to shift the decision distribution toward successful decisions.
As shown in Fig. 6 , we probe both effects at 149 points in the Sokoban test sets where a failed rollout and a successful continuation diverge, by sampling the next decision from their shared history.
First, the noise of the failed rollout now yields the successful decision at 57.0% of the points after CFT, compared with 48.3% after decision-level RFT, which learns from the same continuations without noise mapping.
Second, the correction extends beyond that noise, as CFT chooses the successful decision with an average probability of 67.9% over 32 fresh noises, compared with 65.9% for decision-level RFT and 43.8% for the SFT model.
At the task level, CFT also improves pass@ k k at k = 1 , 2 , 4 k=1,2,4 on both games (see the supplement).
blocks.zh:
分析。 CFT旨在将失败推出的噪音转向成功决定,并通过许多此类更正将决定分配转向成功决定。
如图6所示,我们在索克班测试集的149点探测了这两种效果,其中一次失败的推出和一次成功的延续都存在分歧,我们从他们共同的历史中抽取了下一个决定。
首先,由于推出失败的噪音,在CFT之后,成功的决定率为57.0%,而在决策级的RFT之后,成功决定率为48.3%,而决策级的RFT是在没有噪声映射的情况下从同样的续作中学习的.
第二,纠正范围超出了这种噪音,因为CFT选择成功决定的概率平均为67.9%,高于32个新鲜噪音,而决策级RFT为65.9%,SFT为43.8%。
在任务级别上,CFT还改进了两种游戏的通取@ k k k at k = 1, 2, 4 k = 1, 2, 4(见补充).

blocks.en:
Larger puzzles. We test 100 Sokoban puzzles each with 4 and 5 boxes (up to 3 in training) and 100 FlowFree puzzles on 9 × \times 9 boards (up to 8 × \times 8 in training).
Bidirectional generation solves almost none of them, while frame-wise causal generation solves 32–51% of them, and CFT raises the success rate to 38–74%.
On FlowFree, the solutions are longer than every training video, and the model still stops right after solving the board.

blocks.en:
New layouts. On RoboTwin-Plan, we apply trained rules to new layouts, with Blocks World on the 2 × \times 2 layout and Tower of Hanoi on four pads instead of three.
Chunk-wise generation, the best paradigm on RoboTwin-Plan, solves 36.0% of the Blocks World puzzles, compared with 14.0% for bidirectional generation. CFT breaks the rules no more often than the chunk-wise model, but training on self-generated videos causes more visual defects, which slightly lower its success rate.
Together, these results suggest that our models learn transferable rules rather than only mimicking the training solutions.

Chunk-wise世代是RoboTwin-Plan上最好的范式,解决了36.0%的"Blocks World"谜题,而双向世代则解决了14.0%. CFT打破规则的次数并不多于"分块"模式,但自制视频的培训导致更多的视觉缺陷,这略微降低了其成功率.
这些结果表明,我们的模型学习可转让规则,而不仅仅是模仿培训解决办法。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented ViDecide , a decision-centric framework that teaches video diffusion models to reason and plan step by step. ViDecide generates a solution in causal order and decides when to stop, concentrates training on the high noise levels where decisions are made, and corrects its own failures with CFT.
Across abstract games, planning tasks, and robot manipulation, ViDecide raises the average strict success rate of standard fine-tuning from 23.3% to 83.8% and generalizes to larger puzzles and unseen layouts beyond the training range.
Despite its strong performance, ViDecide is currently trained on one benchmark at a time and relies on rule verifiers for post-training.
In the future, we plan to extend it to broader reasoning data, learned verifiers, and real-world robot planning.
blocks.zh:
ViDecide是一个以决策为中心的框架, ViDecide按因果顺序生成一个解决方案,并决定何时停止,集中培训做出决策的高噪音水平,并用CFT来纠正自己的故障.
ViDecide将标准精细化的平均严格成功率从23.3%提高到83.8%, 并概括为更大的谜题和超出训练范围的无形布局。
尽管表现优异,ViDecide目前每次接受一个基准的培训,并依靠规则核查员进行后期培训.
未来,我们计划把它扩展到更广泛的推理数据, 学习的验证器,以及现实世界的机器人规划。

VideoRLVR. We parse every puzzle of VideoRLVR [ 64 ] into a symbolic state and render it again with one renderer for all games.
Maze videos draw the path at 1.5 frames per move, and Sokoban videos show each move or push over four frames.
FlowFree videos fill one cell at a time along a single continuous walk, which we recover from the drawing order of the original videos.
The walk only switches to a new color at one of its endpoints, after every endpoint of the current color has been visited, and that endpoint must be adjacent to the previous cell.
Since the original test set contains no 8 × 8 8{\times}8 boards and some FlowFree puzzles fail the conversion, we replace them with new puzzles generated following the construction of VideoRLVR, which builds a Hamiltonian path over the board with Warnsdorff’s rule and cuts it into contiguous color segments.
The FlowFree test set thus contains 123 generated puzzles, including all 100 8 × 8 8{\times}8 boards.

RoboTwin-Plan. We build RoboTwin-Plan in the RoboTwin 2.0 simulator 2 2 2 https://github.com/RoboTwin-Platform/RoboTwin [ 5 ] with the dual-arm Aloha-AgileX robot, a clean table, and a fixed third-person camera.
Blocks World uses three or four cubes on three places in a row or a triangle, and the goal arrangement is shown by a small model at the front of the table.
Tower of Hanoi uses three blocks of different sizes on three pads, which must all be stacked on the green pad without placing a larger block on a smaller one.
Color Sorting uses a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 layout of colored pads, where each block must end alone on the pad of its color, either with a free gray buffer pad for three blocks or without one for four blocks.
For each episode, we compute the shortest symbolic plan with breadth-first search and execute it with the grasp and place primitives of RoboTwin, moving one top block at a time.
An episode is kept only if the simulator reaches the goal arrangement and the rendered video passes a replay of the symbolic plan.
Videos are rendered with ray tracing at one frame per 90 simulation steps, and one pick-and-place lasts about 25 frames.
The three splits contain no identical episode.

blocks.en: B Evaluation
blocks.zh: B. 评价

blocks.en:
As noted in Sec. 4.1 , the original evaluations of these benchmarks do not follow the task rules exactly.
VideoRLVR judges Maze and FlowFree on the final frame only and accepts a Sokoban video with up to half of its transitions invalid.
Its precision, recall, and F1 also compare a video with a single reference solution and thus penalize other valid solutions.
VBVR gives partial credit based on pixel heuristics, and VBVR-MultiStep has no automatic evaluation.
Therefore, we build a unified, automatic evaluation pipeline for the Strict Success Rate (SSR) on all benchmarks.
It first detects when each generated video terminates, and then replays its states with a verifier that checks every transition under the task rules.
Following prior work in which LLMs write reward functions as code [ 33 , 52 ] , we build the verifiers agentically.
A coding agent implements the verifier of each task from a few general rules shared by all its instances and refines it until it accepts every reference video.
We then validate the final verifiers against human judgments on generated videos.
blocks.zh:
如第4.1节所指出,对这些基准的最初评价并不完全符合任务规则。
VideoRLVR只在最终帧上评为"Maze and FlowFree"并接受一款索克班视频,最多一半的过渡无效.
它的精度,回想和F1也比较了一段视频和一个单一的参考解决方案,从而惩罚了其他有效的解决方案.
VBVR基于像素回升给予部分信用,而VBVR-MultiStep没有自动评价.
因此,我们为所有基准的严格成功率建立了统一、自动的评价渠道。
它首先检测每个生成的视频终止时,然后用一个核查器来重放其状态,根据任务规则检查每一个过渡.
在LLMs将奖励功能写作代码[33,52]的先前工作之后,我们以代理方式构建了验证器.
编码代理从所有实例共有的几条通则中执行每项任务的核查人,并对其进行完善,直至接受每一个参考视频.
然后,我们验证了最后的核实者 对人类判断 生成的视频。

blocks.en:
Termination. The pipeline begins by detecting the EOS frame of each generated video.
A frame counts as EOS if at least 70% of its border pixels are red, and all frames from the first EOS frame on are ignored.
Causal models stop at this frame or at the maximum length limit of 20 s, and fixed-length models generate their full length.

如果一个帧至少70%的边框像素为红色,而第一个 EOS 帧上的所有帧都被忽略,则一个帧算作 EOS .
致病模型在此框架或最长长度限为20 s时停止,而固定长度模型产生出其全长.

blocks.en:
Verifiers. Every verifier reads the state of each frame, replays the trajectory under the task rules, and reports the first violation. • FlowFree reads the color of every cell from its interior pixels.
A newly painted cell must extend the current color from its tip or start a new color at one of its endpoints next to the previous cell, after all endpoints of the current color have been visited.
Paint may never disappear or change color.
The video succeeds when the board is fully painted without any earlier violation. • Sokoban parses the agent, the boxes, and the targets in every frame.
It rejects hallucinated or vanished objects and requires every change between consecutive settled states to be a legal move or push.
Two moves within one transition are accepted only if their intermediate state appears in a frame.
The video must end with all boxes on targets. • Maze requires the drawn path to stay off the walls and remain connected to the start, and the final path to connect the start and the goal. • VBVR-MultiStep reads a symbolic state per frame with the geometry of each puzzle, and its task-specific rules reject illegal moves and hallucinated, vanished, or teleporting objects.
The shortest-solution requirement compares the number of moves, or the path length for TSP Reward Collection and Ordinal Number Sequence, with the reference solution. • RoboTwin-Plan uses a learned state reader, a frozen DINOv3 [ 44 ] encoder with a transformer decoder trained on the simulator states of the training videos, which predicts the position of every block and whether each gripper holds it.
A Viterbi decoder turns these predictions into a sequence of arrangements, and the rules reject blocks that move without being grasped, duplicated or vanished blocks, and every change between rest states that is not one legal move of a top block, including the size rule of Tower of Hanoi.
A separate appearance classifier on DINOv3 patch features flags local visual defects of the generated frames. We validate the verifiers on reference and generated videos.
All reference videos of the game and VBVR-MultiStep test sets pass, and the RoboTwin-Plan rules accept all 540 expert videos we tested.
The RoboTwin-Plan state reader identifies the held block with 99.9% accuracy and localizes blocks with a median error of 0.6 mm on held-out expert videos, and the full verifier agrees with human labels on over 95% of 140 generated videos.

blocks.en:
FlowFree reads the color of every cell from its interior pixels.
A newly painted cell must extend the current color from its tip or start a new color at one of its endpoints next to the previous cell, after all endpoints of the current color have been visited.
Paint may never disappear or change color.
The video succeeds when the board is fully painted without any earlier violation.
blocks.zh:
FlowFree从内部像素读取每个单元格的颜色.
新画的单元格必须从它的尖端延伸出当前颜色,或者在访问过当前颜色的所有端点后,在上个单元格旁边的某个端点开始新的颜色.
画可能永远不会消失或改变颜色。
影片在版面被完全涂上后成功,没有更早的侵权.

blocks.en:
Sokoban parses the agent, the boxes, and the targets in every frame.
It rejects hallucinated or vanished objects and requires every change between consecutive settled states to be a legal move or push.
Two moves within one transition are accepted only if their intermediate state appears in a frame.
The video must end with all boxes on targets.
blocks.zh:
Sokoban 描述代理,盒子, 和每个帧的目标。
它拒绝幻觉或已消失的物体,并要求在连续定居的各州之间进行的一切改变都是合法的行动或推动。
只有当其中间状态出现在一个框架中时,一个过渡期间的两个步骤才会被接受。
视频必须结束 目标的所有盒子。

blocks.en: Maze requires the drawn path to stay off the walls and remain connected to the start, and the final path to connect the start and the goal.
blocks.zh: Maze要求所绘制的路径远离墙壁并保持与起站点的连接,以及连接起站点和入球的最终路径.

blocks.en:
VBVR-MultiStep reads a symbolic state per frame with the geometry of each puzzle, and its task-specific rules reject illegal moves and hallucinated, vanished, or teleporting objects.
The shortest-solution requirement compares the number of moves, or the path length for TSP Reward Collection and Ordinal Number Sequence, with the reference solution.
blocks.zh:
VBVR-MultiStep每帧读取一个符号状态,每个谜题的几何,其任务特定规则拒绝非法动作并幻觉,消失,或传送对象.
最短的解析要求比较了移动次数,或TSP Reward Collection和Ordinal Number Sequence的路径长度,并比较了参考解.

blocks.en:
RoboTwin-Plan uses a learned state reader, a frozen DINOv3 [ 44 ] encoder with a transformer decoder trained on the simulator states of the training videos, which predicts the position of every block and whether each gripper holds it.
A Viterbi decoder turns these predictions into a sequence of arrangements, and the rules reject blocks that move without being grasped, duplicated or vanished blocks, and every change between rest states that is not one legal move of a top block, including the size rule of Tower of Hanoi.
A separate appearance classifier on DINOv3 patch features flags local visual defects of the generated frames.
blocks.zh:
RoboTwin-Plan使用一个有学问的状态读取器,一个被冷冻的DINOv3 [44] 编码器,并配有一个变压器解码器,训练视频的模拟状态训练,它预言每个街区的位置以及每个抓取器是否持有.
一个维特比解码器将这些预测转换成一系列安排,规则拒绝那些没有被抓住,复制或消失的块来移动的块,其余州之间的每处变化都不是上层块的合法动作,包括河内塔的大小规则.
DINOv3补丁上的单独外观分类器标记生成帧的局部视觉缺陷.

blocks.en:
Strict and relaxed success. A video can reach the goal state while breaking the rules on the way, and Tab. S2 measures how often this happens.
On Sokoban, bidirectional generation reaches the goal state in 98.2% of the videos but follows every rule in only 50.8%, whereas frame-wise causal generation loses only 0.5 points under the strict metric.
The extra goal-reaching videos of bidirectional generation are not solutions, as they break the rules on the way, e.g . , boxes vanish or reappear, the agent duplicates, or objects teleport.
On VBVR-MultiStep, the shortest-solution requirement mainly affects Tower of Hanoi, and the ranking of the paradigms is the same with and without it.
blocks.zh:
严格和放松的成功。 视频可以在路上违反规则的同时到达入球状态,并有Tab. S2测量这种情况的发生频率。
在Sokoban上,双向生成在98.2%的视频中达到目标状态,但只遵循了50.8%的每个规则,而帧式因果生成在严格的度量下只损失了0.5分.
双向生成的额外有目标影响的视频不是解决方案,因为它们在路上打破了规则,例如:盒子消失或再出,代理复制,或物品传送.
在VBVR-MultiStep上,最短的解决方案要求主要会影响河内塔,而范式的排名与它和没有它一样.

blocks.en:
Zero-shot generators. Since the closed-source models are costly to query and almost never succeed under the strict rules, we evaluate them on stratified test subsets.
The subsets contain 20 FlowFree puzzles (five per board size), 20 Sokoban puzzles (seven, seven, and six with one, two, and three boxes), 30 VBVR-MultiStep puzzles (five per task), and 30 RoboTwin-Plan episodes (five per sub-task).
Each model receives the first frame and the task prompt used in training.
Seedance 2.5 generates the length of the reference solution rounded up to whole seconds, between 4 and 20 s, and Veo 3.1 generates its fixed 8 s.
The open models, Wan2.2-5B, VBVR-Wan2.2-A14B 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/Video-Reason/VBVR-Wan2.2 , and VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-5B-RLVR 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/Video-Reason/VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-RLVR , use their default sampling settings and are evaluated on 100 FlowFree puzzles (25 per board size), 100 Sokoban puzzles, 120 RoboTwin-Plan episodes (20 per sub-task), and the VBVR-MultiStep test set.
All outputs are resized to 384 × 384 384{\times}384 , and appended with four EOS frames before the verifiers are applied.
Since these models are not trained to stop or to find the shortest solution, we do not require the optimal number of moves.
As our verifiers are mainly built for the rendering and pacing of our datasets, which these models might not follow, we also review the videos by hand, relax the rules, and accept those whose errors are minor.
blocks.zh:
零发发电机. 由于闭源模型的查询费用高昂,而且根据严格的规则几乎从未成功,所以我们用分级测试子集来评估.
子集包含20个"FlowFree"谜题(每板大小5个),20个"Sokoban"谜题(7个,7个,6个有1个,2个,3个框),30个"VBVR-MultiStep"谜题(每个任务5个)和30个"RoboTwin-Plan"谜题(每个子任务5个).
每个模型都得到培训中使用的第一个框架和任务提示。
种子2.5生成参考溶液的长度被圆绕到整秒,在4至20 s之间,而Veo 3.1生成其固定的8 s.
开放型号为:Wan2.2-5B,VBVR-Wan2.2-A14B 3 3 https://huggingface.co/Video-Reason/VBVR-Wan2.2;和VBVR-Pro-Wan2.2-5B-RLVR 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/Video-Reason/VBVVVR-Pro-Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-RVR,使用其默认的采样设置,并按100个无流谜(每板尺寸25个),100个Sokoban谜题,120个RoboTwin-Plan事件(每分任务20个),以及VBVR-MultiStep测试集.
所有输出量被调整为384×384384\times}384,并在使用核查器前附有四个EOS框架.
由于这些模型没有经过停止或找到最短的解决方案的培训,因此我们不需要最佳的动作数量.
由于我们的验证器主要用于我们数据集的渲染和节奏,这些模型可能不会遵循,因此我们也用手来审查视频,放松规则,并接受出错较小的人.

On VBVR-MultiStep, “shortest” additionally requires the optimal number of moves where the prompt asks for it.
blocks.zh: 表S2 : Wan2.2-5B上一代范式的严格而宽松的成功率(%),在同一视频上得分. “结束状态”只检查最终框架,“严格”还检查每个过渡阶段。 在VBVR-MultiStep上,“最短”的动作还需要在及时要求时达到最佳数量。

blocks.en: C Implementation Details
blocks.zh: C 执行细节

blocks.en: This section gives the training and inference details of our models on Wan2.2-5B and DiT-B, of the baselines, and of post-training.
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍我们有关Wan2.2-5B和DiT-B的模型、基线以及培训后的培训与推断。

blocks.en: C.1 Causal Generation on Wan2.2-5B
blocks.zh: C.1 Wan2.2-5B上的因果生成

blocks.en:
We fine-tune all 5.0B parameters of the diffusion transformer of Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 45 ] and keep the text encoder and the VAE frozen.
The VAE encodes every four frames into one latent frame of 24 × 24 × 48 24{\times}24{\times}48 , which yields 144 tokens, and the first latent frame encodes the initial observation 𝐨 0 \mathbf{o}_{0} .
A segment of K K latent frames thus spans 4 video frames in frame-wise generation ( K = 1 K{=}1 ) and 32 in chunk-wise generation ( K = 8 K{=}8 ).
blocks.zh:
我们微调了Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [45]的所有 5.0B参数,并保持文本编码器和VAE被冻结.
VAE将每四个帧编码成一个由24×24×48 24×24×24}24×时}48的潜伏相框,生成144个令牌,而第一个潜伏相框编码了初始观测o o\ mathbf{o}_{0}.
K潜伏框架的一段因此跨越了相框生成中的4个相框(K = 1 K{=}1)和相片生成中的32个相框(K = 8 K{=}8).

blocks.en:
Training. We train with teacher forcing on a clean and a noisy copy of each video.
Each noisy segment draws its own noise level from p DF ​ ( t ) p_{\mathrm{DF}}(t) and attends to its own noisy tokens and to the clean tokens of all earlier segments.
The loss is the flow-matching objective with the timestep weighting of Wan2.2, and the first latent frame is excluded from it.
The shift s s of Eq. ( 4 ) only changes the training distribution, so all models share one sampling schedule.
blocks.zh:
培训。 我们用老师的强迫来训练每个视频的 干净而吵闹的拷贝。
每个吵吵的片段从 p DF (t ) p_{\ mathrm{ DF}} (t ) 中抽取出自己的吵吵的片段,并注意它自己的吵闹的花纹和早期所有片段的干净花纹.
损失是和Wan2.2的时间步加权相匹配的流量目标,第一个潜在帧被排除在外.
Eq. (4)的班次S只改变训练分布,所以所有模型都共享一个采样时间表.

blocks.en:
Inference. The model generates one segment at a time from a key-value cache of the clean history, with five UniPC steps, a sampling shift of 5, and no classifier-free guidance.
After each segment, we decode it and check for the EOS border, and generation stops at the first EOS frame or after 80 latent frames, i.e . , 20 s.
blocks.zh:
推论. 该模型从清代历史的密钥-值缓存中一次生成一段,有5个UniPC步骤,5个抽样移位,没有无分类器的引导.
每段后,我们解码并检查EOS边框,生成停止在第一个EOS帧或80个潜在帧后,即20 s.

blocks.en: Table S3: SFT settings. All paradigms of a benchmark share these settings, and DiT-B is trained on FlowFree and Sokoban.
blocks.zh: 表S3:SFT设置. 一个基准的所有范式都共享这些设置,而DiT-B在FlowFree和Sokoban上接受了训练.

blocks.en:
Optimization. Tab. S3 lists the optimizer and schedule settings, and all models train with gradient clipping at 1.0 and bf16 mixed precision.
On FlowFree and Sokoban, training has two stages of five epochs, and the second stage keeps the optimizer state and restarts the cosine schedule with a peak of 3 × 10 − 6 3{\times}10^{-6} and 1,500 warmup updates.
blocks.zh:
优化. 标签。 S3列出了优化器和调度设置,以及以1.0和bf16混合精度剪接的所有型号列车.
在"FlowFree"和"Sokoban"上,训练有5个时代的两个阶段,第二阶段保持了最优化状态并重新启动了余弦表,高峰为3×10−6 3×Times}10×6}和1500个热身更新.

blocks.en: C.2 DiT-B
blocks.zh: C.2 双T-B

blocks.en:
Following S2PD [ 21 ] , we also implement our designs on DiT-B [ 37 ] to show that they do not depend on a specific backbone.
DiT-B is a 132M-parameter diffusion transformer with width 768, depth 12, and 12 heads, which operates on 256 × 256 256{\times}256 frames with 32 × 32 32{\times}32 patches, 3D rotary position embeddings, and adaLN-zero conditioning on the noise level, without text input.
Its videos show one frame per move and end with one EOS frame.
It predicts the clean frame, and the loss is weighted by 1 / max ⁡ ( t , 0.05 ) 2 1/\max(t,0.05)^{2} with t t drawn from a logit-normal distribution with mean log ⁡ s \log s and unit variance.
Its learning rate decays linearly to zero over the last 1,000 updates, and we evaluate the EMA weights.
Sampling uses five Euler steps per frame on a uniform noise grid with a key-value cache.
blocks.zh:
在S2PD[21]之后,我们还在DiT-B[37]上实施了设计,以表明它们并不依赖于特定的骨干.
DiT-B是一款132M-参数扩散变压器,宽度为768,深度为12,并有12个头,运行在256×256×256}256帧上,有32×32×32}32个补丁,3D回转位置嵌入,并有声平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平
它的视频显示每个动作一个帧并用一个EOS帧结束.
它预测干净的帧,损失被加权1/最大QQ (t, 0.05) 2 1/\max (t, 0.05)\\2}, t t取自一个正数正常的分布,平均log QQ s\log s和单位相差.
它的学习速率在过去1000个更新中呈线性衰减为零,我们评价EMA的权重.
采样在有密钥值缓存的统一噪声网格上采用每帧5个欧乐步.

blocks.en: C.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: C.3 基线

blocks.en:
Bidirectional generation. The bidirectional baseline uses the original Wan2.2-5B or DiT-B architecture and denoises all frames of a clip jointly with a single noise level, with the first latent frame fixed to the initial observation.
Every training video is extended to a fixed length by holding its final EOS frame, and this length equals the longest training video of each task.
blocks.zh:
双向生成. 双向基线采用原Wan2.2-5B或DiT-B架构,并用单个噪声水平联合将剪辑的所有相框相接而成,第一个相框固定在初始观测上.
每个训练视频通过持有其最终的EOS帧被扩展为固定长度,而这个长度相当于每个任务最长的训练视频.

blocks.en:
HDR and S2PD. We implement both methods on our backbones following their papers and train them with the same data, shift, and number of training videos as the bidirectional baseline.
On FlowFree and Sokoban, their second training stage starts from the first-stage weights with a new optimizer state.
HDR [ 38 ] denoises a hierarchy of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32 keyframes and finally all latent frames, each level conditioned on the coarser ones, and we sample it with 5, 8, 13, 20, 32, 50, and 50 Euler steps from the coarsest to the finest level.
S2PD [ 21 ] trains on a mixture of single-frame blocks and whole-video blocks with a noised context, and its sampler first generates frames one at a time down to noise level 0.6 and then denoises all frames in parallel, with 10 Euler steps in total.
blocks.zh:
《人类发展报告》和S2PD。 我们遵循他们的论文,在骨干上实施两种方法,并用与双向基线相同的数据、转移和培训视频数量培训他们。
在"FlowFree"和"Sokoban"上,他们的第二个训练阶段从第一阶段的重量开始,有了一个新的优化状态.
HDR[38] 将1,2,4,8,16和32个键框分出等级, 最终是所有潜在框架, 每个级别都以相近的框为条件, 我们用5,8,13,20,32,50和50欧拉的阶梯进行抽样, 从相近的阶梯到最好的阶梯。
S2PD [21]列车搭载由有噪声上下文的单帧区块和全视频区块混合而成,其采样器首先一次生成一帧到噪声级0.6,再将所有相框平行地去除,总共有10个欧乐步.

blocks.en: C.4 Post-Training
blocks.zh: C.4 培训后

blocks.en:
Collecting corrections. We roll out the SFT model twice on each training puzzle, including the 5,000 harder puzzles of each game, locate the first error of every failed rollout with the verifier, and resample four continuations from a branch point shortly before the error, keeping the successful ones.
On FlowFree, the branch point lies at most four moves before the fatal move.
On Sokoban, it lies four latent frames before the first state that an exact solver proves unsolvable.
On VBVR-MultiStep, it is the last settled state before the first violation, redundant move, unsolvable state, or early stop.
On RoboTwin-Plan, it is the rest state before the first violation or detour.
For each successful continuation, the divergence step d d is the first segment at which it departs from the failed rollout.
Tab. S4 lists the numbers of corrections.
On VBVR-MultiStep and RoboTwin-Plan, failures are collected on the three and four sub-tasks with the lowest success.
blocks.zh:
收集更正。 我们在每个训练谜题上两次推出SFT模型,包括每场游戏的5000个更难的谜题,找到每个失败的推出的首个出错与验证器,并在出错前不久从分站点重现出4个续作,保留了成功的出错.
在"FlowFree"上,分行点位于致命移动前的最多4个动作.
在Sokoban上,它存在四个潜在框架,第一个状态是精确的解子证明是无法解的.
在VBVR-MultiStep上,它是第一次侵权前最后解决的状态,冗余移动,无法解决状态,或者提前停止.
在RoboTwin-Plan上,这是第一次违规或绕道之前的其余州.
对于每次成功的延续,分歧步骤d是它偏离失败推出的第一部分。
Stab. S4列出了更正的编号。
在VBVR-MultiStep和RoboTwin-Plan上,三和四个子任务收集失败,成功率最低.

blocks.en: Table S4: Post-training settings. “Corrections” is the number of successful continuations used for post-training, and the number in parentheses counts the training puzzles, or RoboTwin-Plan episodes, from which they are collected.
blocks.zh: 表S4:培训后设置。 “更正”是指用于培训后的成功续读次数,括号中的数字算作培训拼图,或RoboTwin-Plan节目,从中收集。

blocks.en:
CFT. CFT starts from the full training state of the SFT model and trains for about two epochs over the corrections.
Each training row is a successful continuation together with its history, and half of its loss weight lies on the divergence segment 𝐗 d + \mathbf{X}^{+}_{d} , where the corrective loss of Eq. ( 6 ) reuses the noise ϵ d − \boldsymbol{\epsilon}^{-}_{d} of the failed rollout and draws t = 1 t{=}1 with probability 0.5.
The other half covers the remaining segments with the decision-focused objective.
Expert videos fill a quarter of each batch, which sets λ \lambda in Eq. ( 8 ).
On DiT-B, we additionally keep an EMA of the weights with a decay of 0.99.

blocks.en:
Baselines. All post-training baselines start from the same SFT model and use the same number of updates and learning-rate schedule as CFT on each benchmark.
Decision-level RFT trains on exactly the corrections of CFT with fresh noise at the divergence segment and samples its timesteps only from p DF ​ ( t ) p_{\mathrm{DF}}(t) , without the extra weight at t = 1 t{=}1 .
Sample-level RFT trains on successful whole rollouts of the SFT model together with expert videos.
Continued SFT trains on expert videos of the same puzzles.
The online methods alternate collection and training in rounds, eight rounds on FlowFree and VBVR-MultiStep, six on Sokoban, and four on RoboTwin-Plan.
Each round of the sample-level variants rolls out four videos for each puzzle in a new group of training puzzles, and each round of the decision-level variants branches four continuations at the same number of failures, located with the rule of CFT.
The reward is the strict success of the verifier, including the shortest-solution requirement on VBVR-MultiStep, and expert videos fill a quarter of each batch.
Flow-GRPO [ 29 ] uses one stochastic sampling step with a noise level of 0.7, a clipping range of 0.01, and a KL coefficient of 0.04.
DiffusionNFT [ 62 ] uses a KL coefficient of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and we scale its loss by 0.02 on Wan2.2-5B and 0.03 on DiT-B so that its gradient norm matches that of CFT.
Otherwise the success rate of its rollouts drops quickly within three rounds.

blocks.en:
Teacher forcing and diffusion forcing [ 4 ] are two ways to train a causal video model.
Teacher forcing conditions each frame on the clean history, whereas diffusion forcing trains every frame with an independent noise level, so that each frame is conditioned on a noisy history.
We train the frame-wise model of Tab. 1 with diffusion forcing, keeping its data, schedule, and number of updates, and follow its paper in re-noising the generated history to noise level t = 0.1 t{=}0.1 at inference.
As Tab. S7 shows, causal generation with adaptive termination outperforms every fixed-length method whether it is trained with teacher forcing or diffusion forcing.
This indicates that the gain comes from generating the solution step by step and deciding when to stop, rather than from how the causal model is trained.
Teacher forcing is better in three of the four settings, by 6.0 points on average, and needs no re-noising at inference, so we use it in all other experiments.

老师强迫每个框架在干净的历史上设置条件,而扩散则强迫火车每个框架具有独立的噪音级别,这样每个框架就以吵闹的历史为条件.
我们训练 Tab. 1 的帧模型 具有扩散的强迫性, 保存它的数据, 时间表, 和更新的次数, 并遵循它的论文 重命名生成的历史 到噪音水平 t = 0.1 t = = 0.1.
作为 Tab. S7显示,适应性终止的因果生成超过每一种固定长度的方法,无论它是否受过教师强迫或传播强迫的培训。
这表明,收益来自逐步生成解决方案,决定何时停止,而不是如何培训因果模型。
教师强迫在四个场合中,有三个是较好的,平均得分6.0分,在推论上不需要再点名,所以我们在所有其他实验中都使用.

Sampling steps and inference cost. Tab. S8 studies how the number of sampling steps per segment affects accuracy and inference time.
Our models change little beyond the five steps used in all other experiments, whereas bidirectional generation keeps improving but stays well below them, e.g . , 69.2% with 20 steps on RoboTwin-Plan against 82.5% for our five.
With five steps, our models take 3.9–11.5 s per video, compared with 2.7–3.1 s for bidirectional generation, 141–188 s for HDR, and 13.2–14.6 s for S2PD, both of which are also less accurate.
At a similar time per video, they are far more accurate, e.g . , 73.5% with two steps against 44.0% for bidirectional generation with 20 steps on Sokoban.

The model trained with s = 10 s{=}10 is the best under every sampling shift on all four benchmarks, so the gain of the decision-focused schedule does not depend on the sampler.
It also remains the best with only two sampling steps, e.g . , 60.0% against 49.5% for s = 5 s{=}5 on FlowFree.

Most of these defects are distortions of the moving arm, whose new pose is generated at high noise levels, where the larger shift puts more training.

Probe construction. The probe uses the models of Tab. 5 on Sokoban.
We roll out the SFT model on the test sets and keep every failed rollout for which a continuation resampled from an earlier step succeeds, exactly as CFT collects its training data, which gives 67 points on the test set and 82 on Sokoban-Hard.
At each point, every model generates the next decision from the shared history 𝐡 d \mathbf{h}_{d} , once with the noise ϵ d − \boldsymbol{\epsilon}^{-}_{d} of the failed rollout and once with each of 32 fresh noises, which are the same for all models.
The verifier parses the board after the decision and labels it as the successful decision, the failing decision, or another move.
Fig. S3 shows two examples, at which CFT generates the successful decision with 91% and 88% of the fresh noises, compared with 16% and 19% for the SFT model.

Successful decisions and safe moves. Tab. S10 complements Fig. 6 .
We also count safe moves, i.e . , legal moves after which the puzzle remains solvable, which we check with an exhaustive Sokoban solver.

The failed rollout often loses the puzzle only one to four steps after the divergence, so its decision at the divergence point is itself safe at 63.8% of the points, although it leads to failure.

Noise mapping and timestep distribution. CFT differs from decision-level RFT in two ways: it reuses the noise of the failed rollout, and its corrective loss places extra samples at t = 1 t{=}1 (Eq. ( 6 )).
Tab. S11 separates the two on FlowFree.
Reusing the failure noise brings the larger gain on the test set under either timestep distribution, 3.5–3.6 points on Wan2.2-5B and 3.5–4.4 points on DiT-B, compared with 0.7–0.8 and 2.2–3.1 points for the extra samples at t = 1 t{=}1 .
Combining both, as CFT does, gives the best test SSR on both backbones.

blocks.en:
Self-generated versus solver corrections. For rule-based games like FlowFree and Sokoban, an exact solver can provide a correction for every failed rollout, including those for which no resampled continuation succeeds.
We test whether such corrections can replace the self-generated ones of CFT.
Starting from the same branch points as CFT, we complete each failed rollout with the solver, render the completion with our renderer, and encode the video.
On Sokoban, we use a shortest solution, and on FlowFree, the solution that keeps the path of the failed rollout for as long as the puzzle remains solvable.
Training uses the same objective as CFT, which pairs the solver segment at the divergence step with the noise of the failed rollout, as well as the same expert share and learning-rate schedule, and runs for two epochs over its own data (11,324 and 9,388 updates with batch 2).
This gives 8,494 corrections from 6,259 puzzles on FlowFree and 7,039 from 4,601 puzzles on Sokoban, 2.8 and 1.7 times as many puzzles as the self-generated corrections (Tab. S4 ).
blocks.zh:
自我生成对解者修正. 对于"FlowFree"和"Sokoban"等基于规则的游戏,一个精确的解答器可以为每次失败的推出提供更正,包括那些没有再被复制的续作成功.
我们检验这种修正是否能够取代CFT自行产生的修正。
从与CFT相同的分支点开始,我们用解析器完成每次失败的展开,用我们的渲染器完成完成,并编码视频.
在Sokoban上,我们使用一个最短的解决方案, 在Flowfree上, 只要谜题仍然可以解开,这个解决方案就能够维持失败的推出路径。
训练使用与CFT相同的目标,将相差级的解析器段与失败推出的噪音相配,以及相同的专家分享和学习率时间表,并用自己的数据(11 324个和9 388个更新与第2批)运行两个纪元.
这给出了来自"Flowfree"上6,259个谜题的8,494个更正,以及来自"Sokoban"上4,601个谜题的7,039个更正,2.8个和1.7个比自发更正(Tab. S4.)的多.

blocks.en:
As Fig. S4 shows, solver corrections are worse than self-generated ones at every checkpoint on both games, although they cover more puzzles.
On FlowFree, they fall far below the SFT model, reaching 48.2% on the test set and 22.2% on FlowFree-Hard after two epochs, compared with 84.4% and 52.0% for CFT, as the model often stops before the board is filled or breaks a path.
On Sokoban, they improve over the SFT model but stay below CFT, with 86.9% and 74.8% compared with 90.8% and 78.2%.
Self-generated corrections lie within the model’s own distribution and only change which decision the noise leads to.
By contrast, solver corrections lie outside it, and fitting them disturbs the generation itself.
Corrections are therefore most effective when drawn from the model’s own distribution, even though a solver covers more puzzles.
blocks.zh:
如来相. S4显示,解析器的校正比两款游戏的每个出站点的自发校正更糟糕,虽然它们覆盖了更多的谜题.
在"FlowFree"(FlowFree)模式上,它们远低于SFT模式,在测试集上达到48.2%,在"FlowFree-Hard"上达到22.2%,而CFT则达到84.4%和52.0%,因为该模式经常会于棋盘被填满或被突破前停放.
在Sokoban上,它们比SFT模式有所改善,但保持在CFT以下,为86.9%和74.8%,而90.8%和78.2%。
自发的校正属于模型本身的分布范围,只有改变噪音导致的决定。
相比之下,解决者修正则位于其之外,而加以调整则会扰乱一代人本身。
因此,如果从模型本身的分布中抽取,即使一个解谜者覆盖更多的谜题,校正最有效.

blocks.en: D.8 Comparison with Frontier Multimodal Language Models
blocks.zh: D.8 与边疆多式联运模式的比较

blocks.en:
Given the rapid progress of LLMs, a natural question is how video models compare with the frontier ones, which can reason about such puzzles in text.
We give two of them, Claude Opus 5.5 6 6 6 https://www.anthropic.com/claude and the open Qwen3.8-27B 7 7 7 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B , the first frame and the task prompt of each puzzle and ask for the moves as text.
The same verifiers replay their answers, and Tab. S16 compares them with ViDecide on 50 random puzzles from each game test set.
Qwen3.8-27B runs in thinking mode with its default sampling settings and up to 32K new tokens.
Opus 5.5 solves almost every puzzle, while ViDecide outperforms Qwen3.8-27B by 14 to 54 points.
The two settings differ in what the model must produce.
A language model answers with a short move sequence after a long reasoning trace, a median of 11.2K tokens for Qwen3.8-27B, whereas a video model solves the puzzle by generating every intermediate state as a frame, so a single wrong frame fails the video.
The video also models how the scene changes physically, e.g . , a robot arm grasping, carrying, and placing blocks on RoboTwin-Plan, which a text answer leaves out.
As an academic study, we use open models to explore how far video models can reason by generating their own state transitions, and combining them with language-model planners is a promising direction.
blocks.zh:
鉴于LLMs的快速进展,一个自然的问题是如何将视频模型与前沿模型进行比较,这些模型可以在文本中为这些谜题作解释。
我们给出了其中两个,克洛德·奥普斯·5.5 6 6 6 https://www.harmic.com/claude和开放式的Qune3.8-27B 7 7 7 https://huggingface.co/Quen/Qune3.8-27B,这是每个谜题的第一个框架和任务提示,并要求将动作作为正文。
同样的核查者重放他们的答案,和Tab. S16用每个游戏测试集的50个随机谜题将它们与ViDecide进行比较.
Quen3.8-27 (中文(简体) ). B以默认的采样设置运行在思维模式下,并有多达32K个新令牌.
Opus 5.5几乎解决了每一个谜题,而ViDecide则以14到54分的成绩超过了Qune3.8-27B.
两种环境在模型必须产生什么方面有所不同.
一种语言模型在长推理追踪后以短动序列回答,为Quen3.8-27B的中位数为11.2K令牌,而视频模型则通过生成每个中间状态作为帧来解谜,因此单个错误的帧会使视频失效.
视频还模拟了场景的物理变化,例如机器人手臂抓住,携带,并给RoboTwin-Plan上放置了块块,一个文本答案省去.
作为一种学术研究,我们使用开放模型来探索视频模型通过产生自己的状态过渡可以实现多大程度的理性,而将视频模型与语言模型规划者结合起来是一个很有希望的方向.

blocks.en: F Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: F. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Scope of training. To keep the comparisons clean and controlled within our compute budget, we train one model per benchmark on its own training data.
Training a single model on larger and more diverse reasoning data, possibly mixed with general video data, is a natural next step toward video models that solve a broad range of tasks.
blocks.zh:
培训范围。 为了在计算预算范围内保持比较的清洁和控制,我们根据自己的培训数据,每个基准培训一个模型。
培训一个更大的、更多样化的推理数据单一模型,可能与一般视频数据相混合,是解决广泛任务的视频模型的自然下一步。

blocks.en:
Rule verifiers. Like other methods based on verifiable rewards [ 64 , 53 ] , CFT relies on a verifier, which here checks every state transition to locate the failures that CFT corrects.
Such verifiers can be built agentically for tasks with explicit rules (Sec. B ), but are harder to obtain for open-ended tasks.
Learned verifiers or VLM judges could extend CFT to these tasks.
blocks.zh:
规则核查员。 和其他基于可核查奖励的方法[64,53]一样,CFT依赖于一个验证器,在此检查每一个州的过渡,以找到CFT纠正的故障.
这种核查员可以具有明确规则(B节)的任务的代理作用,但难以获得无限期的任务。
受过培训的核查员或普通法庭法官可以将这些任务扩大到打击资助恐怖主义。

blocks.en:
From videos to actions. Our work focuses on improving video models themselves, and RoboTwin-Plan evaluates the generated plans as videos in simulation.
Executing them on real robots requires converting the videos into actions, e.g . , with an inverse dynamics model [ 11 ] , which we leave to future work.
As recent world-action models build on video generation models [ 25 , 58 , 26 , 13 ] , video models with stronger physical consistency and longer-horizon planning could also provide a better foundation for them.
blocks.zh:
从视频到动作。 我们的工作重点是改进视频模型本身,RoboTwin-Plan在模拟中将生成的计划评价为视频.
在真正的机器人上执行它们需要将视频转换成动作,例如,使用反向动态模型[11],我们留待未来工作.
由于最近的世界行动模型建立在视频生成模型上[25,58,26,13],具有更强物理一致性和较长视野规划的视频模型也可以为它们提供更好的基础.
